svg.title: Featured: EquityLens, our COS 301 capstone, with Amazon Web Services as industry client. See why your portfolio moved, not just that it did. Built by a team of four; 404 of the commits are mine. Screenshot of the dashboard plotting a portfolio against the Satrix 40 benchmark, with a dot on each day a holding moved unusually far.

g.text: See why your portfolio moved, not just that it did.
Each dot is a day one holding moved unusually far for itself. Click it
for the event study and the news around it.
